ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via MSEDGE_PROXY.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "msedge_proxy.exe" to download arbitrary files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\_proxy\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msedge\_proxy\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
